levels.title: רמה 1: משפט קצר אחד בהווה
passages: I have a big red ball.
The cat is on the bed.
My dog can run and jump.
This is my mom and dad.
I like to eat pizza.
The sun is hot today.
We go to school by bus.
She has a blue bag.

levels.title: רמה 2: שני משפטים קצרים
passages: My name is Dana. I am ten years old.
I have a little brother. He likes to play football.
There is a park near my house. I go there with my friends.
My mother works in a shop. She gets up early every morning.
We have a small garden. There are many flowers in it.
I like English lessons. My teacher is very nice.
On Friday we eat dinner together. My grandmother makes soup.
The children are in the classroom. They are reading a book.

levels.title: רמה 3: משפטים מחוברים עם and, but, because
passages: It is raining today, so we cannot play outside. We are watching a movie at home.
My best friend lives next to me. We walk to school together every day.
I want a dog, but my father says no. He thinks a dog is a lot of work.
Every summer we go to the beach. I love to swim in the sea and build sand castles.
My sister is good at math, and I am good at sports. We help each other with homework.
I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast. Can I have a sandwich, please?
There are five people in my family. We live in a small town near the mountains.
After school I do my homework first. Then I ride my bike with my friends.

levels.title: רמה 4: סיפורים קצרים בזמן עבר
passages: Yesterday we visited my grandparents. My grandfather told us a funny story about his school.
Last week I lost my phone on the bus. A kind woman found it and called my mother.
We went to the zoo on Saturday. The monkeys were funnier than the lions.
I woke up late this morning and missed the bus. My father drove me to school.
My cousin came from America last month. She brought me a beautiful book about animals.
It was my birthday on Tuesday. My friends made a surprise party, and I was very happy.
We played basketball after school. Our team won because everyone worked together.
The test was harder than I thought. I studied a lot, so I answered most of the questions.

levels.title: רמה 5: קטעים ארוכים עם עתיד ודעות
passages: Next year I will start a new school. I am a little nervous, but I think I will make new friends quickly.
If it is sunny tomorrow, we are going to have a picnic in the forest. Everyone should bring something to eat.
I have never been to another country. One day I would like to visit London and see the famous bridge.
My brother wants to become a doctor when he grows up. He says that helping people is the most important job.
We should take care of our planet. We can save water, use less plastic, and plant more trees.
Although I was tired, I finished my science project. The teacher said it was one of the best in the class.
Many children spend too much time on their phones. It is healthier to play outside and meet friends.
Last summer we traveled to the north for a week. We slept in a tent, cooked on a fire, and looked at the stars.

levels.title: רמה 6: פסקה שלמה ואוצר מילים רחב
passages: My grandmother grew up in a small village without electricity. She walked five kilometers to school every day, and in the evening she helped her parents on the farm. She says life was harder then, but people were closer to each other.

Dolphins are some of the smartest animals in the ocean. They live in groups and talk to each other with special sounds. Scientists have discovered that every dolphin has its own name, a whistle that the others recognize.

Last month our class organized a market to collect money for an animal shelter. We sold cakes, old books, and toys. By the end of the day we had earned more than two thousand shekels, and everyone felt proud.
I used to be afraid of speaking English in front of other people. Then my teacher gave me some advice: practice a little every day and do not worry about mistakes. Now I feel much more confident.

The city is planning to build a new library next to the park. It will have thousands of books, quiet rooms for studying, and a small cafe. Many families in the neighborhood are excited about the idea.

When my father was a child, there were no smartphones or computers at home. Children played outside until it got dark and wrote letters to friends who lived far away. Sometimes I wonder which childhood was better.

levels.title: רמה 7: טקסט מידע וסיפור עם משפטים מורכבים
passages: Although plastic is cheap and useful, it has become a serious problem for the environment. A plastic bottle can stay in the sea for hundreds of years. That is why many countries are trying to reduce the amount of plastic that people throw away.

If I could travel anywhere in the world, I would choose Japan. I have always been interested in its culture, its food, and its modern technology. I would especially like to see the cherry trees when they bloom in spring.

The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens more than a hundred years ago. Only fourteen countries took part, and all the athletes were men. Since then the Games have grown enormously, and today thousands of athletes from around the world compete.

Yesterday something strange happened on my way home. An old man stopped me and asked whether I had dropped a wallet. It was not mine, so we took it to the police station together. The owner was found within an hour.

Reading is one of the best ways to improve a language. When you read a story, you learn new words without even noticing. Experts recommend choosing books that are interesting to you, even if they seem a little difficult at first.

My sister has been learning to play the violin for three years. At first the sounds she made were terrible, and our neighbors complained. However, she never gave up, and last week she performed in front of the whole school.

קוראים לי דנה. אני בת עשר.
